name: @tol/queue
description: earlier: the shared apps/api <-> apps/worker job contract — queue/job names, per-job data shapes, and typed enqueue functions apps/api calls directly (never BullMQ/ioredis specifics leaking into apps/api's own service code, same 'packages own the mechanism, apps consume it' discipline as every other package in this monorepo). apps/worker's own job PROCESSING (handlers, registry, worker-runtime) stays in apps/worker — this package is the producer-side contract both apps share, not the consumer.
